newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures close near day's highs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures close near day's highs.

text.p: U.S. debt futures closed near daily highs set late in the day as commodity prices broke down, fanning ideas that U.S. inflationary pressures were waning in the second half of the year, traders and analysts said.
"There is the feeling that we are seeing a major break down in these components," one floor trader said.
The Commodity Research Bureau's (CRB) Index fell more than 1.50 percent as grain and oil prices fell sharply.
